description: List market benchmark indices (id, slug, name, currency), sorted by slug. Use this to resolve a benchmark name like 'SORA' into the `marketIndexId` required by `get_index_quotes`.
name: list_market_indices

currency.description: Currency the benchmark is quoted in, or null when not recorded.

id.description: Index id; pass it as `marketIndexId` to `get_index_quotes`.

slug.description: Short stable identifier of the benchmark.

title: List market indices
